To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
state representation learning methods can be classified into three categories: unsupervised methods, supervised methods and reinforcement learning methods.

(1) state representation learning is a very active area of research, with many different approaches and applications, (2) there is a clear trend in the community to use deep learning methods for representation learning and (3) there are many different ways to assess the quality of the representation learned.

(i) state representation learning methods can learn low-dimensional representations that are more suitable for policy learning algorithms; (ii) these methods can improve the performance of control policies; (iii) these methods can be used to solve control problems with complex dynamics and high dimension; (iv) the learned representations can be used to interpret the environment and the learned policies; and (v) the representation can be learned in an end-to-end fashion, i.e., without the need for a separate policy learning algorithm
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of new methods to learn representations that are suitable for control tasks.
developing algorithms that learn state representations that are suitable for control.
the following question: How to learn a representation of the state space to facilitate control?
